title: Beyond the Answer Key: Robustness Evaluation of Large Language Models for Step-Level Mathematical Verification
abstract: arXiv:2608.28725v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as graders, verifiers, and process auditors, but most mathematical evaluations still emphasize final-answer accuracy. This can obscure whether a model can verify a non-canonical but valid solution trace. We introduce a controlled linear-equation benchmark for evaluating LLMs in the evaluator role. Each instance asks the model to judge final-answer correctness, step-level trace correctness, and the first incorrect step. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art open LLMs reveals a significant robustness gap: models that accurately evaluate canonical solutions often fail when presented with perturbed but logically equivalent variants. Across GPT-OSS 20B, Qwen3-14B, and Phi-4-Reasoning, base models perform well on canonical traces but degrade substantially on perturbed traces, especially for error localization. translated_title: 超越答案之钥：大语言模型在步骤级数学验证中的鲁棒性评估
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作评分员、验证器和过程审计员，但大多数数学评估仍然强调最终答案的准确性。这可能掩盖了模型是否能够验证非规范但有效的解题过程。我们引入了一个受控的线性方程基准，用于评估LLM在评估者角色中的表现。每个实例要求模型判断最终答案的正确性、步骤级解题过程的正确性，以及第一个出现错误的步骤。我们对最先进开源LLM的评估揭示了一个显著的鲁棒性差距：能够准确评估规范解法的模型，在面对经过扰动但逻辑等价的变体时往往表现不佳。在GPT-OSS 20B、Qwen3-14B和Phi-4-Reasoning上，基础模型在规范解题过程上表现良好，但在扰动过程上性能大幅下降，尤其是在错误定位方面。在有效的扰动解题过程上，基础模型的错误拒绝率达到75.6-85.3%，表明……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个线性方程基准来评估大语言模型作为数学验证者的能力，发现模型在面对逻辑等价但非规范的解题过程时鲁棒性严重不足，错误拒绝率高达75.6-85.3%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a linear-equation benchmark for evaluating LLMs as mathematical verifiers, revealing a significant robustness gap where models achieve false-rejection rates of 75.6-85.3% on valid but non-canonical perturbed solution traces.
